title: Field minimization
description: Queries return only the fields explicitly requested, never whole records by default. The requester declares the needed fields; anything else is withheld. Minimization is enforced at the retrieval layer so application code cannot accidentally over-fetch. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers returning only requested fields.

title: k-anonymity grouping
description: Quasi-identifiers like age and ZIP are generalized until every combination appears in at least k records. A 34-year-old in ZIP 12345 becomes 30-39 in 123**. k-anonymity bounds re-identification risk for released datasets. Suppression handles groups that cannot reach k. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers generalizing quasi-identifiers to groups of k.
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: Differential privacy noise
description: Calibrated random noise (Laplace or Gaussian) is added to aggregate query results so individual records cannot be reverse-engineered. The noise scale is set by the privacy budget epsilon: smaller epsilon means more privacy and noisier answers. Budgets compose across queries. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers calibrated Laplace noise on aggregates.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 1.0, 2: 0.5, 3: 0.1}
EPS = CFG[LEVEL]
import random
random.seed(51)
true_count = 1000
noise = random.expovariate(EPS) - random.expovariate(EPS)  # laplace(1/eps)
print("true:", true_count, "| epsilon:", EPS, "| released:", round(true_count + noise))
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: Purpose-limited queries
description: Every query declares its purpose, and the controller checks the purpose against the data's allowed uses before executing. Research queries cannot touch data consented only for operations. Purpose declarations are logged with the query for audit. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers declared purpose per query.

title: Suppression of small cells
description: Aggregate cells computed over fewer than a threshold number of records are suppressed, because tiny groups are re-identifiable. Suppressed cells are marked, not silently dropped, so consumers know data was withheld. The threshold is set per dataset. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers suppressing aggregates over tiny groups.
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.
